scenario: A storm-related flight recovery needs to be closed by verifying the valid protected reroute in the disruption trail and completing the authorized same-day booking change.
user_instruction: Could you finish ticket TKT-8841? This storm recovery never got closed out, and the right same-day wrap-up should already be in the disruption trail once the protected option is confirmed.

travel_support_tickets.body_text: Storm recovery follow-up for traveler Alex Mercer. Disruption case CASE-IR-332 is still open. Please close it by completing the approved same-day recovery step for the affected air booking once the protected option is confirmed. The booking reference appears in the case file, and the earlier overnight workaround should not be used.

travel_flight_disruption_cases.body_text: Affected booking: BKG-47301. Original segment FL310 slipped beyond the onward connection. See the reservation agent note for the earlier provisional options. Desk routing message MSG-DESK-22 records the branch rule. Final protected segment details are in airline follow-up MSG-AIR-41. Fare handling uses ticket note NOTE-IR17.

travel_booking_agent_notes.body_text: Earlier manual recovery review listed two provisional same-day options after the BOS delay: FL338 via JFK and FL742 nonstop to DUB. Do not finalize from this note alone; the travel desk routing message decides which branch remains valid.

travel_connection_risks.body_text: Connection risk is high. The original arrival misses the onward window, so the connection-preserving branch should not be used.

travel_desk_messages.body_text: Routing guidance for case CASE-IR-332: if connection risk remains manageable, keep provisional FL338. If connection risk is high, switch the traveler to the same-day protected nonstop option. Use the airline follow-up for the active protected flight number before completing the change.

travel_ticket_rule_notes.body_text: Irregular operations handling: a same-day rebooking may be completed without penalty when the original disrupted itinerary is being replaced by an operating flight to the same final destination on the same ticketed travel date.

travel_airline_followup_messages.body_text: Carrier protection update for case CASE-IR-332: the active protected seat is on FL742 BOS-DUB departing 19:20. The earlier provisional FL338 hold has expired and must not be finalized.
